reference: Z. Moser, J. Dutkiewicz, W. Gasior, and J. Salawa, Bull. Alloy Phase Diagrams, 6(4), 330-334 (1985) doi:10.1007/bf02880511; compiled in H. Okamoto, Desk Handbook: Phase Diagrams for Binary Alloys, 2nd ed., ASM International, Materials Park, OH (2010), p. 820
comment: evidence_class=assessed_phase_diagram (expert-drawn diagram, not experimental, not CALPHAD); ORCHID assessed-phase-assemblages v1.0.0, diagram SN-ZN-p820; one point per phase field (centroid or pole of inaccessibility); single-phase: the phase at the point composition; two-phase: phases present, compositions unknown (null) with __HYPERPLANE__ at the point's overall composition.
